h: From Ardent Preparation to the Stillness of Shabbos

p: along the lines of what they said (Berachos 58a)
Certainly now the king is coming," etc.;
is like the kingdom of heaven," etc.,
"Hashem is not in the wind," etc.;
"Hashem is not in the earthquake," etc.;
and after the fire, a still, small voice."
And this is why we first say,
and it needs to be "with speech and with voice."
And afterward, "before the Master of the worlds":
and stands actually before Him, blessed be His Name,
then it is "not a noisy thing."
For the matter of wind, earthquake and fire
which precede the still, small voice
are preparation for the root of unification
and attachment to the One Hashem.
For "wind" is the yearning and the will
at the beginning of entering holiness,
when it is with great intensity,
"There is no strength like piety at its beginning."
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
whose spirit and will moved him
against all the kings of the earth
in order to publicize His kingship, blessed be His Name;
and this is only the way and the preparation
to come to the words of Torah,
כְּאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּאָבוֹת (אָבוֹת ו, ד)
And after the wind, the earthquake:
this is the aspect of the middah
of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
it is an earthquake and quaking of the earth,
for he trembled at the word of Hashem.
הוּא בְּחִינַת מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
this is the aspect of the middah of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"And the house of Yaakov will be fire";
which is the matter of attachment to Him, may He be blessed,
וְהִנֵּה עַל כׇּל אֵלֶּה הַמַּדְרֵגוֹת נֶאֱמַר (שְׁמוֹת ו, ג)
Now concerning all these levels it says (Shemos 6:3):
to Yitzchak and to Yaakov," etc.,
"but My Name Hashem I did not make known to them";
which is the matter of the true unification
that from them the holiness of Yisrael would descend,
who would receive the Torah in actuality
For although the Avos fulfilled the Torah
for them it was only from their own intellect
אָמְנָם מַדְרֵגַת מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
But the level of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
is the very essence of unification,
in receiving the Torah from Heaven,
which is attachment at the root
and this is the aspect of the still, small voice.
And through the holiness of Shabbos
is in ceasing from human action,
one receives the flow of holiness quietly,
And this is alluded to in "before the Master of the worlds":
when one comes to this level,
before Him, may He be blessed,
to be attached to the root,
but only with a still, small voice,

paragraphs.text: Source: Berachos 58a — “… ה׳ עבר ורוח גדולה וחזק מפרק הרים ומשבר סלעים לפני ה׳ לא ברוח ה׳ ואחר הרוח רעש לא ברעש ה׳. ואחר הרעש אש לא באש ה׳ ואחר האש קול דממה …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 147) — “This heretic said to him: How do you know this? Rav Sheshet said to him: Royalty on earth is like royalty in the heavens, as it is written with regard to God’s revelation to Elijah the Prophet on Mount Horeb: …”
